description: Current base fee and priority-fee percentiles (10th, 50th, 99th) for Ethereum, Base or Arbitrum from public RPC nodes, with the next block's base fee projected from the last block's fullness (EIP-1559 rule). Solana is not included here. Forecasts are a one-block projection, not a congestion model. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
